meta.title: Plans
meta.description: Lists every plan this Session submitted for review, newest first — in the right sidebar and on a page beside Chat. A composition bar and counters split the plans by outcome, chips filter the list, and a card reads the plan in place — drawn by the host's markdown renderer, or by the plugin's own when that is unreachable — with the review feedback when it was sent back. Plans are read from the Session log: exit_plan_mode calls, and ExitPlanMode calls in imported Claude Code Sessions. The plugin only reads the Session, never writes to it, and needs no approvals. Open it from the sidebar guide or the Plans view in the header.
